mapper.insert: insert into project( project_no, project_name, project_purpose, project_visibility, project_start, project_deadline ) values ( #{projectNo}, #{projectName}, #{projectPurpose}, #{projectVisibility}, #{projectStart}, #{projectDeadline} )
mapper.select: select p.project_no as projectNo, p.project_name as projectName, p.project_purpose as projectPurpose, p.project_visibility as projectVisibility, p.project_start as projectStart, p.project_deadline as projectDeadline, p.project_member_role as projectMemberRole from project p inner join project_member pm on p.project_no = pm.project_no where pm.emp_no = #{empNo} and p.project_status = 'active' order by p.project_ctime desc
mapper.update: update project set project_name = #{projectName}, project_purpose = #{projectPurpose}, project_visibility, = #{projectVisibility}, project_start = #{projectStart}, project_deadline = #{projectDeadline} where project_no = #{projectNo}
